subject: You are verified on QuotesDone: please confirm your categories
body:
Dear ZZ DEMO PL plumbing 1be65ab2,

Your company is now verified on QuotesDone. Our sales engineer has reviewed your registration documents, and your supplier account is approved.

From your documents we have set these categories for your company:
• Plumbing & sanitary

What to do now (about two minutes):
1. Open your supplier portal: https://quotesdone.com/portal
2. In the Services tab, check that the categories are correct, and press "Remove this trade" for any your company does not work in.
3. Add any categories and services we missed, then press "Confirm my services".

Inquiries are matched to the categories and services you confirm, so the sooner you confirm them, the sooner the right inquiries reach you.

Need help? Reply to this e-mail or message us on WhatsApp.

Kind regards,
QuotesDone Customer Support
